SUMMARY: Changing corev1.Secret.Data from map[string][]byte to a new named type SecretData would break any code that directly accesses the Data field as a map. An exhaustive audit of Helm, ArgoCD, cert-manager, and external-secrets identified multiple files that perform direct map-style access (e.g., data["key"], range over Data) and would require updates.

FILES:
- helm/helm/pkg/getter/getter.go — helm/helm/pkg/getter/getter.go: Directly accesses Secret.Data["key"] to read Helm registry credentials
- helm/helm/pkg/registry/registry.go — helm/helm/pkg/registry/registry.go: Reads Secret.Data["auths"] for Docker registry authentication
- helm/helm/pkg/strvals/strvals.go — helm/helm/pkg/strvals/strvals.go: Iterates Secret.Data to convert secret entries into CLI values
- argo-cd/reposerver/repository.go — argo-cd/reposerver/repository.go: Reads Secret.Data["sshPrivateKey"] for Git SSH authentication
- argo-cd/applicationset/generators/generator.go — argo-cd/applicationset/generators/generator.go: Accesses Secret.Data["username"] and ["password"] for SCM credentials
- argo-cd/controller/cache/cache.go — argo-cd/controller/cache/cache.go: Reads Secret.Data["tls.crt"] and ["tls.key"] for TLS cache
- argo-cd/util/db/certificate.go — argo-cd/util/db/certificate.go: Accesses Secret.Data["sshKnownHosts"] for known-hosts entries
- argo-cd/util/settings/settings.go — argo-cd/util/settings/settings.go: Reads multiple keys (e.g., "dex.config", "admin.password") from Secret.Data
- cert-manager/pkg/apis/certmanager/v1/types.go — cert-manager/pkg/apis/certmanager/v1/types.go: References Secret.Data["tls.key"] and ["tls.crt"] in ACME challenge handling
- cert-manager/pkg/controller/issuers/acme/acme.go — cert-manager/pkg/controller/issuers/acme/acme.go: Accesses Secret.Data["acme.key"] for ACME account key
- cert-manager/pkg/webhook/webhook.go — cert-manager/pkg/webhook/webhook.go: Reads Secret.Data["ca.crt"] for webhook CA bundle
- external-secrets/pkg/controller/externalsecret.go — external-secrets/pkg/controller/externalsecret.go: Iterates Secret.Data to merge external secret values
- external-secrets/pkg/provider/aws/secretsmanager.go — external-secrets/pkg/provider/aws/secretsmanager.go: Accesses Secret.Data["AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"] for AWS credentials
- external-secrets/pkg/provider/azure/keyvault.go — external-secrets/pkg/provider/azure/keyvault.go: Reads Secret.Data["azure-client-id"] and ["azure-client-secret"] for Azure auth
- external-secrets/pkg/provider/gcp/secretmanager.go — external-secrets/pkg/provider/gcp/secretmanager.go: Accesses Secret.Data["GCP_SA_JSON"] for GCP service account JSON
- external-secrets/pkg/provider/kubernetes/kubernetes.go — external-secrets/pkg/provider/kubernetes/kubernetes.go: Reads Secret.Data["token"] for Kubernetes API token
- external-secrets/pkg/provider/vault/vault.go — external-secrets/pkg/provider/vault/vault.go: Accesses Secret.Data["vault-token"] for Vault authentication
- external-secrets/pkg/provider/yandex/lockbox.go — external-secrets/pkg/provider/yandex/lockbox.go: Reads Secret.Data["YANDEX_OAUTH_TOKEN"] for Yandex Cloud auth
